g.text: Greenhollow → Millbrook → Port Sapphire → Darkfang → Crystal Cave · topology only, not legacy coordinates
Guided order includes service/story towns; Darkfang is the first mandatory dungeon. Crystal entry opens only when boss.giantToad.defeated === true.
One-way story rhythm; optional spurs stay visible without
competing with the compass. Strongest first-time readability.
• Natural forward momentum, little forced backtrack
• Distinct landmark clearings and strong barrier buffers
• Minimap reads as one spine + three deliberate side stories
Two unmistakable service hubs. Darkfang returns the player
to Port before Crystal; simplest map, most repeated ground.
• Greenhollow and Port act as memorable navigation anchors
• Best minimap clarity and easiest route validation
• Cost: mandatory Port backtrack after Darkfang
A memorable loop turns forest into a landmark. Exploration
feels richest, but the compass must work harder to lead.
• Strongest sense of place and optional wandering
• Loop reduces some return trips after Port
• Cost: busiest minimap and weakest novice route hierarchy
LOCKED ACROSS ALL OPTIONS: blocked forest · natural dirt trails · separate semantic layers · distinct approach clearings · no legacy geography · Crystal gate on the only Act 2 path
